summary: Deterministic checks anchor both the evidence surface and the rails around autonomous execution.

items.text: Feed deterministic build, test and policy results into Trust Layer; the safety net generates non-negotiable evidence, while the layer makes it reviewable with other signals.
Use the safety net as a hard postcondition for YOLO with Rails so unattended work cannot argue past a failing deterministic check.
Order the test infrastructure into a defect-specific Reproduce–Patch–Prove recipe: demonstrate red on baseline, apply the smallest causal patch, then demonstrate green and run the wider checks.
See Agent Pipelines & Triggered Roles for the related use case or counterpoint: Treat the agent workflow as a pipeline. Roles join at defined points or on triggers — not ad-hoc.
See Council: Review Verdicts Need a Reaction for the related use case or counterpoint: Every named review finding gets an accountable decision: fix, accept with reasons, or escalate.

See Skip the Pull Request for the related use case or counterpoint: In agent-first delivery, gates in front of the integration merge replace the human pull-request review — the operator reads verdicts, not diffs.
See Spec-Driven Development for the related use case or counterpoint: The spec is the source of truth, not the code.
